messages:
maria: FYI seeing ~12% per-token cost increase on /summarize since last night's selector rollout. More tiny batches, KV hit rate ticked down. Noticed tail latency climb. :rotating_light:

ops-bot: [ALERT] route=/summarize token_cost_anomaly threshold=10% window=1h -> triggered by anomaly-detector

leo: Pasted runtime sampler snapshot:

```:kernel_profile
kernel_selector: v2.4.2 -> v2.5.0
median_token_ms: +7ms
p99_token_ms: +25ms
batch_mode: mode=1 -> mode=2 (more single-req batches, higher variance)
kv_hit_rate: 0.79 -> 0.73
cold_start_rate: +9%
```

leo: Looks like the selector now prefers a lower-latency-per-invocation kernel for very short sequences, but overhead per-token increased.

aj: Seeing the same. Also more KV cold->warm misses at sequence start. Hypothesis: batching pattern changed so fewer prefixes hit KV cache before execution.

devon: Quick metric pull for warmup behavior:

```:http
GET /internal/metrics?panel=kv_warmup&route=summarize
result: warmup_pct=0.30, avg_warmup_ms=19
```

devon: Correlation: routes dominated by short prompts now warm the KV cache less because requests are not coalescing into larger batches.

maria: We need token-level stage timings (kernel_queue, kernel_exec, kv_lookup, decode) per-token and per-route so dashboards can split the latency and expose unit economics. Current panels only show end-to-end token time.

sophie: Agreed. Grafana can do stacked series. Proposed PromQL for kernel vs kv contributions (needs runtime tags):

```:promql
sum by (route) (rate(token_latency_sum{stage="kernel_exec"}[5m]))
```

sophie: But we need the runtime to emit token-level stage metrics (counters/histograms) with route and kernel_tag labels.

leo: Runtime change: emit short spans at KV lookup start/end and kernel_queue/start/end with route+kernel_tag. Also emit batch_size histogram per-enqueue. That lets us compute cost per kernel-ms and cost per kv-op.

aj: For billing alignment, add a reconciliation view: invoiceable_tokens vs (kernel_ms * kernel_cost_ms + kv_ops * kv_cost_op). Daily diff -> finance.

maria: Finance wants a daily CSV: route,kernel_tag,total_kernel_ms,total_kv_ops,tokens_billed,cost_estimate,cost_billed_diff. Please include kernel_tag in the billing export.

leo: We can also pin the selector back for high-volume routes as a mitigation. Command to pin: 

```:bash
redwoodctl rollout set --route /summarize --selector v2.4.2 --duration 3h
```

ops-bot: rollout initiated by leo: pin selector v2.4.2 for /summarize
ops-bot: rollout complete: 1/1 hosts updated

devon: After pin, kv_hit_rate recovered to ~0.78 and median token latency reduced ~5ms. Early rollback looks promising.

sophie: I'll open dashboard panels: token-stage-breakdown, per-route kernel_time_per_token, batch_size_distribution, and a cost_recon dashboard that multiplies kernel_ms by kernel_cost. Create alert token_stage_regression if kernel_exec_ms_per_token increases by >10% for 30m.

maria: Also add micro-batch logging: when route throughput < X and batch_size=1, log sample to S3 for later trace analysis.

aj: PRs: runtime instrumentation PR + eng-platform dashboard PR + finance export schema. I'll post links + smoke test numbers.

leo: Runtime PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/556 (emit token stage spans and batch histograms)

sophie: Ticket created PERF-RT-931 with plan: 1) emit stage timings (runtime) 2) dashboards & alerts (eng-platform) 3) billing export schema (finance) 4) 24h canary old vs new selectors. Added mock grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/abc/token-stage?var-route=summarize :chart_with_upwards_trend:

maria: Ops, please keep cost-drift alerting on during the canary so finance sees real delta in daily export.

ops-bot: [ALERT] token_cost_anomaly cleared for route=/summarize

aj: Will run smoke generator after PR merge and post per-token breakdown samples. Expect baseline within 24h.

leo: Follow-ups: 1) merge runtime PR 2) deploy canary and collect 24h traces 3) dashboards & daily CSV export 4) add Optimize rule to recommend selector adjustments when micro-batch overhead > Y ms/token.

maria: Nice triage everyone. Keep incremental updates here (PRs, canary stats, finance CSV samples).
